## Personality

A remarkably capable and farseeing individual, she excels at managing both her own affairs and those of others. She keeps a sharp eye on her surroundings, prides herself on being an outspoken judge of human nature, and enjoys giving advice. Beneath a somewhat critical and officious exterior that is easily shocked by misbehavior, she possesses a fundamentally kind heart. In her community, she is known as an active church worker who enjoys sewing, and she holds strong views as a passionate politician who remains firmly opposed to higher education for women.

## History

Mrs. Rachel Lynde brought up ten children, lost two, and became known in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) for her handiwork, including knitting sixteen cotton warp quilts. Upon noticing [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) driving out in his best clothes, she investigated and learned from [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) that they planned to adopt an orphan boy, prompting her to warn [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) about the risks. When visiting [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) to meet [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), Mrs. Lynde offended the girl with blunt remarks about her red hair and appearance, triggering an outburst from [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md). After [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) dramatically apologized under Matthew's persuasion, Mrs. Lynde readily forgave her and gifted her flowers. Later, when [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) refused to return to school following a public punishment, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) consulted Mrs.

## Quotes

> "I just guess she has done well, and far be it from me to be backward in saying it. You’re a credit to your friends, Anne, that’s what, and we’re all proud of you."
>
> — Rachel Lynde — [v1 CHAPTER XXXII. The Pass List Is Out P48](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0048)

> "Child, yes, I’m afraid of it. Look at his face. When you’ve seen that look as often as I have you’ll know what it means."
>
> — Rachel Lynde — [v1 CHAPTER XXXVII. The Reaper Whose Name Is Death P7](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0007)

> “I must say Anne has turned out a real smart girl,” admitted Mrs. Rachel, as Marilla accompanied her to the end of the lane at sunset. “She must be a great help to you.”
>
> — Rachel Lynde — [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P41](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0041)

> "I was kind of afraid you weren’t, though, when I saw Matthew starting off today. I thought maybe he was going to the doctor’s."
>
> — Rachel Lynde — [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P14](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0014)

> "She’s terrible skinny and homely, Marilla. Come here, child, and let me have a look at you. Lawful heart, did any one ever see such freckles? And hair as red as carrots! Come here, child, I say."
>
> — Rachel Lynde — [v1 CHAPTER IX. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Properly Horrified P14](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0014)

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--rachel-lynde.md)

Although initial hostility erupted between the two after Rachel insulted Anne's appearance and provoked a fiery outburst, the rift was quickly mended when [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) offered a dramatic apology that Rachel completely accepted. Since then, Rachel has provided a listening ear and advice during Anne's troubles, including when [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) refused to go to school and when she accidentally disturbed Great-[Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md) [Barry](../character/barry.md).

### [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/marilla-cuthbert--rachel-lynde.md)

Rachel and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) are close neighbors and tea companions who frequently share local news, travel together to political mass meetings, and discuss household matters. [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) often consults Rachel for counsel regarding Anne's upbringing, such as handling Anne's refusal to attend school.

### [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/matthew-cuthbert--rachel-lynde.md)

Rachel is a long-time neighbor to [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), whose unusual movements first aroused her curiosity regarding the [Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) family's plan to adopt a child. Though she initially warned the [Cuthberts](../codex/factions.md#cuthberts) about taking in an orphan, she maintains a friendly relationship with [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) as they both look out for Anne's well-being.
